name: United Blood Nation
description: The United Blood Nation (UBN), also known as the East Coast Bloods, is a prison-originated gang confederation founded on July 16, 1993 at Rikers Island by Omar 'O.G. Mack' Portee and Leonard 'OG Dead Eye' McKenzie, who merged independent African American inmate gangs into a unified front against rival Latino organizations including the Latin Kings and Ñetas. Membership is estimated at 7,000–15,000 nationwide, concentrated along the East Coast. The gang derives income primarily from drug trafficking, robbery, extortion, and prostitution. Subgroups include Nine Trey Gangsters and Sex Money Murder.
